entities.name: Hensoldt AG
entities.description: Sensor-tech de defesa aleman (radar, optronico, EW). H1 2026 CUMPRIDO: order intake dobrou €2.812B, backlog record €10.356B, revenue +23.6% €1.167B, FY confirmado €2.75B, EBITDA 18.5-19%.
entities.catalyst: FY2026 guidance €2.75B confirmado; novos contratos Bundeswehr Q3-Q4; expansao NATO procurement
entities.red_flags: 75% dos contratos sao com governo alemao — dependencia de orcamento Berlin; Rheinmetall maior e compete pelos mesmos contratos
entities.why_now: H1 com order intake record que leva backlog a 3.7x receita anual; FY guidance conservadora dado H1 ja excelente; rearmamento europeu nao abrandou — HENSOLDT e beneficiario direto
entities.access_note: Disponivel em XETRA via qualquer neobroker europeu

entities.name: Theon International
entities.description: Sistemas de visao noturna e optronika de defesa. H1 2026 CUMPRIDO: revenue +35.4% €248.7M, order intake +38.5% €232.5M. HGH acquisition closing ANTECIPADO para H1 2027.
entities.catalyst: HGH closing H1 2027 — adiciona FLIR sensors industriais; Q3 2026 contratos NATO potenciais
entities.red_flags: Origem grega — percepcao de risco politico; HGH integration risk; pricing power vs concorrentes US (Elbit, L3Harris)
entities.why_now: Revenue +35% mas P/E ~15x — desconto face a peers US em +25x; HGH closing nao totalmente precificado; NATO procurement de visao noturna em aceleracao com conflito Ucraniano
entities.access_note: Listado Euronext Amsterdam — acessivel via DEGIRO, Trade Republic, etc.

entities.name: Exosens
entities.description: Sensor defense tech frances (image intensifiers, photonics). H1 2026 CUMPRIDO: revenue +15.3% €253.1M, adj EBITDA 33% margin record, guidance upper end €520-540M. Antiga Photonis.
entities.catalyst: FY2026 guidance upper end €520-540M; ITAR export licenses para aliados NATO; H2 defense spending acceleration
entities.red_flags: Fraca cobertura de analistas — discovery limitada; ITAR restrictions podem limitar mercado US; margem EBITDA 33% pode ser peak se raw materials sobem
entities.why_now: EBITDA 33% record numa defense company europeia e raro; guidance upper end = H2 acceleration; sub-coberto face a Thales/Safran — potencial re-rating quando analistas cobrem
entities.access_note: Listado Euronext Paris — acessivel diretamente por investidor frances

entities.name: Renk Group AG
entities.description: Sistemas de transmissao e propulsao para blindados. H1 2026 CUMPRIDO: order intake €1.2B +30%, backlog €7.4B 5.3x TTM, adj EBIT 15.4%, David Brown Defence Q4 2026 ~£200M, US Army IDIQ $691M.
entities.catalyst: David Brown Defence closing Q4 2026; US Army IDIQ $691M deliveries 2026-2027; Leopard 2 upgrade programs
entities.red_flags: Backlog elevado cria risco de execucao; David Brown integration complexa; exposicao a atraso em programas Bundeswehr
entities.source: https://ir.renk.com Renk Group H1 2026 results Aug 2026; David Brown acquisition
entities.why_now: Backlog 5.3x TTM = visibilidade de receita excecional; US Army IDIQ e primeiro contrato significativo nos EUA — abre mercado novo; David Brown adiciona propulsao naval (Type 26 frigate UK)
entities.access_note: Disponivel em XETRA — acessivel via neobroker europeu

entities.name: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions
entities.description: Drone-jets autonomos (Valkyrie), Space Force, cyber. Q2 CUMPRIDO: $458.8M +19.1%, FY $1.70-1.76B, Space Force OTA $446.8M, backlog $2B, JPMorgan upgraded Overweight. Valkyrie 8→40 unidades.
entities.catalyst: Valkyrie producao ramp 8→40 unidades; Space Force OTA $446.8M deliveries 2026-2027; Q3 earnings Nov
entities.red_flags: Valuation esticada ~50x earnings; risco de cancelamento de programas de drones USAF; competicao General Atomics, Boeing
entities.source: https://ir.kratosdefense.com Kratos Q2 2026 earnings Aug 2026; JPMorgan upgrade
entities.why_now: Gate Q2 CUMPRIDO com beat; JPMorgan upgrade pos-resultados; Valkyrie e o programa mais avancado de drone-jet autonomo nos EUA — primeiro a escalar producao em escala

entities.name: Planet Labs PBC
entities.description: Constelacao de 200+ satelites de observacao da Terra para intelligence. FY26: $307.7M +26%, backlog $900M +79%, adj EBITDA $15.5M primeiro ano lucrativo, NDR 116%.
entities.catalyst: Breakeven EBITDA confirmado; backlog $900M +79% = crescimento visivel 3+ anos; contratos defense/intelligence Q3-Q4 2026
entities.red_flags: Preco de acao muito volatil; competicao SpaceX Starshield, Maxar (Maxar adquirida); cash burn historico elevado
entities.why_now: Primeiro ano EBITDA positivo = inflexao narrativa de burn para profitable; backlog +79% com NDR 116% mostra retencao e expansion de clientes; geopolitica eleva valor de GEOINT comercial

entities.name: Anduril Industries
entities.description: Defense tech startup de Palmer Luckey — Lattice AI OS, drones, sistemas autonomos. Pre-IPO mas acessivel via ETF PRNT (proxy). Valuation ~$28B. Contratos USAF/Army.
entities.catalyst: IPO potencial 2026-2027; contratos DoD multi-biliao 2026; Lattice OS expansao aliados NATO
entities.red_flags: ETF PRNT tem exposicao diluida — Anduril e apenas uma das posicoes; pre-IPO valuation pode ser excesso; competicao Palantir em AI defense
entities.source: https://www.ark-invest.com/funds/prnt ARK 3D Printing ETF; Anduril funding rounds 2026
entities.why_now: Anduril e a defense-tech mais falada dos EUA sem IPO — PRNT da exposicao parcial; contratos DoD em aceleracao; Lattice OS potencial de licenciamento a aliados
entities.access_note: PRNT e ETF US — verificar se disponivel com KIID na EU; alternativa: esperar IPO Anduril
